readout_other: Visual Analog Scale and AVHRS for hallucinations; resting-state fMRI striatal-superior temporal connectivity
direction_notes: Hallucination severity and frequency fell after active LIFU to NAc and CH, and striatal-STC connectivity fell relative to baseline; no formal sham comparison was possible.
safety_notes: No adverse events associated with stimulation; mild transient auditory sensations reported; simulated temperature rise at most 0.6 C and MI under 1.9.

timing.protocol_description: 20 Hz pulse repetition frequency, 6% duty cycle (3 ms pulses, 50 ms interval), applied in 40 s on / 20 s off cycles for 30 minutes per hemisphere (60 minutes total).
